extDescription.message: Save the text you reuse, search it, and copy it with one click. Bulk-import from CSV or TSV. Works fully offline.

btnPopoutTip.message: Open in a separate window (the side panel closes)

btnDockTip.message: Move back to the side panel (this window closes)

detailBtnTip.message: Read the whole thing (you can edit and copy it here too)

emptySubAdd.message: Use “+ New” to add them one at a time.

emptySubImport.message: Or select three columns in a spreadsheet — category, title and body — copy them, and paste them into the import screen. CSV files work too.

emptyNote.message: The import screen is behind the ⚙ button in the header.

noResultsSub.message: Try another search term or category.

labelTitle.message: Title (this is what the list shows)

importHint.message: Three columns are read: category, title and body. The setting below applies both to pasting and to reading a file.

importPasteHint.message: Select the three columns in your spreadsheet, copy them, and paste below.

importFileHint.message: CSV and TSV files are supported. The delimiter (comma or tab) is detected for you. Save the file as UTF-8.

dropZoneAria.message: Choose a file, or drop one here

exportHint.message: Save what you have to a file. CSV and TSV files can be read straight back in.

undoHint.message: You can take back the last thing you did — saving, adding, deleting or importing. Press it again to put it back.

noticeDirty.message: You have changes that are not saved

confirmLeave.message: You have changes that are not saved. Discard them and go back to the list?

toastNeedInput.message: Enter a title or some body text

toastDeleted.message: Deleted. You can take it back from “Undo” behind the ⚙ button.

toastDeletedAll.message: Deleted everything. You can take it back from “Undo” behind the ⚙ button.

toastWindowFailed.message: Could not open a separate window

toastNoBrowserWindow.message: There is no browser window to go back to

toastSidePanelFailed.message: Could not open the side panel

toastPasteEmpty.message: Paste the data you want to import

importNoRowsSkipped.message: No rows could be read ($1 skipped)

confirmReplace.message: Replace everything you have saved ($1) with what you are importing ($2)?
